changeSet.sql: IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM [Setting] where ID = 68) BEGIN INSERT INTO [dbo].[Setting] ([ID], [FieldName], [Name], [Description], [DefaultValue]) VALUES (68, 'LineageVersion', 'Lineage Version', 'This setting indicates which version of lineage the current environment is set to. Each version of lineage functions very differently so care should be taken before changing this value.', '1') END

changeSet.author: Pappas
changeSet.sql: insert into CompanySetting (CompanyID, SettingID, Value) select C.CompanyID, 68 as SettingID, iif(C.Value = 'false', '2', '1') as Value from Setting S inner join CompanySetting C on C.SettingID = S.ID and C.Value = 'false' where S.ID = 46 and C.CompanyID not in (select CompanyID from CompanySetting where SettingID = 68)
